title: Seconds that save lives
summary: Improve life safety and security with Honeywell Technologies' connected monitoring and predictive analytics to detect utility risks faster and protect critical assets.
body_markdown:
### Transform utility life safety with connectivity and predictive analytics


Sometimes the smallest moments make the biggest difference. A minor gas leak, invisible to the naked eye, or an equipment failure that goes unnoticed can make the difference between a marginal issue and a serious incident in the field.


Fortunately, advanced technologies can help mitigate risks before they become emergencies. Honeywell’s connected monitoring and control systems with predictive analytics empower utility operators to detect potential hazards faster and respond more quickly, across the grid.


> Quote:
>
>
> Honeywell systems give our operators the visibility they need to make informed decisions that protect people and operations every day.


Ashley


Compliance Manager


### Life safety and security


Safer operations reduce accidents, protect reputations and strengthen overall resilience. By investing in integrated, human-centric technologies, utilities are better positioned to comply and protect employees and customers while safeguarding critical assets.


- **Intelligent monitoring and control systems** — **** Detect potential issues before they escalate
- **Advanced safety and compliance technologies** — Provide near real-time visibility to support faster, more coordinated responses during critical events
- **Robust access control and asset protection** — Safeguard equipment and data from unauthorized access or tampering
- **Proven safety systems** — Help utilities maintain regulatory compliance and ensure resilient, reliable operations across traditional and advanced energy environments


### Connected monitoring


Improving life safety and security isn’t just about reacting — it’s about *anticipating* . Honeywell’s connected monitoring systems integrate IoT-enabled devices, sensors and predictive analytics to help detect risks across the grid, giving teams the insight to act in near real time.


As we look at how these capabilities take shape in different regions, Honeywell offers tailored offerings designed to meet the unique needs of customers in North America, Europe and the Middle East, Turkey and Africa (META).


### North America


Utilities across North America have a wide range of tools to help keep operations and communities safe. Connected products like the NXU Residential Smart Gas Meter can help detect leaks early, while line locating solutions reduce the risk of accidents by pinpointing underground infrastructure before excavation begins. Water and gas leak detection technologies can identify small problems before they escalate.


Honeywell Forge Performance+ for Utilities ties it all together with predictive insights across the network. With near real-time visibility into emerging risks, utility teams can respond more quickly, strengthen reliability and improve safety outcomes across large geographic areas and distribution service locations.


### [NXU Residential Smart Gas Meter](https://automation.honeywell.com/us/en/campaigns/sme/nxu)


Precise, reliable and connected gas detection solutions for modern residential networks


- **Remote shutoff valve** to stop gas flow from anywhere
- **Ultrasonic flow sensing** for consistent, accurate readings
- **Integrated pressure monitoring** to detect anomalies early
- **Smart connectivity** for real-time monitoring and billing


### [Line locating](https://automation.honeywell.com/us/en/campaigns/sme/line-locating-is-taking-a-big-step-forward)


Line-location services for damage prevention, enhanced safety and future-ready operations


- **Accurate utility line locating** to protect assets and workers
- **Operational efficiency** that reduces truck rolls, administrative work and costs
- **Digital mapping and GIS integration** for precise underground line data


### [Water leak detection](https://buildings.honeywell.com/us/en/products/by-category/sensors/water-detectors/water-leak-detector)


Leak detection for protecting critical equipment and facilities from water damage


- **Early leak detection** to prevent equipment damage
- **Versatile placement** for air handlers, raised floors, sump pumps and drains
- **Proactive alerts** to reduce downtime and maintenance costs


### [Gas leak detection](https://automation.honeywell.com/us/en/products/sensing-solutions/gas-and-flame-detection)


Hazardous gas leak identification to help protect people, property and the environment


- **Comprehensive coverage** for facilities of all sizes
- **Advanced detection technologies,** including gas detectors, flame detectors and natural gas alarms
- **Rapid alerts and easy operation** to enable fast response and maintain a safer workplace


### [Honeywell Forge Performance+ for Utilities](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/honeywell-forge)


A powerful digital platform that connects meters, software and services to provide full visibility across the grid


- **Boosts reliability** by helping prevent downtime and improving service continuity
- **Speeds decisions** with actionable intelligence for faster responses
- **Improves efficiency** by optimizing asset performance and reducing costs


### Europe and META


Utilities in countries across Europe, including Germany, Spain, France​, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom, as well as in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Egypt, face a distinct set of challenges — from stringent regulatory requirements and aging infrastructure to rising energy transition demands.[Honeywell Forge Performance+ for Utilities](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/honeywell-forge) supports most of these needs by delivering predictive maintenance, enhanced situational awareness and operational standardization across diverse, often multicountry networks.


### Deliver safety and resilience accross the grid


At Honeywell, protection and reliability are at the heart of everything we do. By combining intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics and connected technologies, utilities can anticipate risks, act quickly and help prevent incidents before they escalate — because every second can save a life.
